cards.title: Chains of elif
cards.body: Python checks each condition from top to bottom and stops at the first True one. Order your checks from the highest value to the lowest.

cards.title: Why the order matters
cards.body: If the `>= 50` check came first, a speed of 120 would print okay and never reach the fast check. The first match wins.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: score >= 50 is True first, so Python prints pass and skips every branch below it.
